body:
Measured on the owner's laptop

## Retained change
DirectWrite now holds a COM owner for immutable borrowed/owned font bytes instead of copying every font. Font set, weights, rasterization, atlases, allocator and UI are unchanged. The vendored Windows backend joins workspace CI; its new regression checks pointer identity and stream lifetime for both borrowed and owned data.

## Final laptop evidence
Intel Core Ultra 9 185H, 1920x1080/100%, maximized 1920x1009 client, Graphite, offline copies of parity.db, board 7283/task 60253. Three fresh processes per screen, sampled eight seconds after maximizing. Decimal MB, medians:

| Screen | Working set before | Working set after | Private before | Private after |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| inbox | 87.536 | 81.043 | 63.529 | 59.941 |
| board | 87.474 | 81.056 | 63.455 | 59.884 |
| task | 88.470 | 82.203 | 64.352 | 60.772 |

Baseline: e5ce3d0d0ff75affe060dc4e3813d87c2ecadfdc. Final: 1b073500b6ce4e2a31634bab2bffe48259f7b77b.
Current-at-start main was already below 100 MB; the owner's older 116–160 MB observation was not reproduced, and this patch does not claim that entire earlier reduction.

All three fresh-launch screenshots and all three matching resize/minimize/maximize sequence screenshots are pixel-identical to the baseline. The scripted recovery capture has an existing smaller drawn region on both baseline and final; this patch preserves, rather than fixes, that unrelated behavior.

The two-buffer experiment measured only 0.03–0.07 MB lower working set, within sample variation, and was dropped. The final swap chain still has three buffers.

## Proof and safety
- [Final CI: all four jobs green](https://github.com/hypertask-ai/hypertask-desktop/actions/runs/40030576460). Windows backend: 20 passed, zero failures, including `custom_font_stream_retains_original_borrowed_and_owned_bytes`.
- `gates/ram-round.sh` mirrors the requested public-worktree runner, waits for SHA-bound CI, downloads/hash-verifies the artifact using scratchpad `lh-put.sh`, and shares the laptop behavior lock. CI status is read once per minute.
- App/DB execution only in `C:\Users\valen\AppData\Local\Temp\htram`; installed Desktop and APPDATA/Hypertask untouched. No builds or tests executed on the VPS.
- Local evidence: `/home/valentin/projects/hypertask-desktop-wt-ram/evidence/ram/{baseline,fonts,two-buffers,final}`. Acceptance ledger: `.unlazy/ram/GATES.md`, 6 met, 0 unmet/abandoned. No private DB or screenshot data committed to the public repo.
- Every push followed fetch/rebase. Main advanced with separate AI work at 00:08 +0200, after the final 23:58 push; the numbers above are specifically for the recorded baseline and final SHAs, not the later AI changes.
